name: The Eye of Gaia
axiom: The globe IS the eye. The HUD IS the vision. Right eye = touch. Left eye = sight. Moon = lens. Pupil = gaia = 1.

right_eye.what: the hand that reaches. Au first. Klein down.

left_eye.location: rest of HUD — all data panels
left_eye.what: the Mandelbrot table, desk, HUD, easel — all visual processing

lens.flip: lens inverts image. Left sees right. Right feels left. Optic chiasm.

cone_of_view.fovea: 0-2 degrees — green dot — maximum resolution — gaia=1

interpupillary_distance: which layer the human visitor is on inside her focal view. The dashed line through the pupil. Close = sharp. Far = soft.
